programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Drama's For Nerds Part 2: Hallway to Hell
programmes.d: Jenelle and David return for a monstrous showdown with Nathan and Barb, while Kail, Leah and Chelsea try to get Jenelle and Briana kicked off the show.
Briana visits Delaware for Lincoln's birthday but does not get a warm welcome from Kailyn. David is upset when Nathan butts into his relationship with Jenelle. Leah takes Gracie to therapy.
Leah gets a surprising call from Jeremy during the twins' birthday. Kail goes to court with Lux's dad. Jenelle takes a birthday vacation with all her children. Chelsea faces off with Adam.
Javi gets some work news that puts pressure on his relationships with both Briana and Kailyn. Chelsea and Cole confront Adam's parents for the first time since court.
Briana finds out about Javi's big plans, Kail has to go to court mediation with Jo, Leah tries to rehome some unexpected guests, and Jenelle and David get a visit from the sheriff's office.
Briana and Javi make major choices about their relationship and Javi turns to Kailyn. Ali's health issues become more obvious, worrying Leah. Chelsea surprises Cole with the baby's gender.
Briana asks an ex to take care of her after her plastic surgery but Javi isn't happy. Jenelle spends one-on-one time with Jace at therapy. Aubree and Cole go off to a Father/Daughter dance.
Leah and Kailyn vacation together in Hawaii. Chelsea and Aubree meet up with Taylor and Adam's younger daughter, Paislee. Briana heads to her surgery, but receives an unexpected visitor.
Jenelle encounters an aggressive driver while taking Jace home. Briana has some surprise visitors after surgery. Leah gets troubling news. Kailyn and Jo go back to court.
Briana faces DeVoin as she heals from surgery. After a disheartening doctor's visit, Leah receives an update on Ali's condition. Adam violates his visitation agreement.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Seaon 8 Finale Special - Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 1
programmes.d: In part one of the explosive two-part reunion, Chelsea, Leah, Kailyn, Jenelle and Briana join Dr Drew to discuss the highs and lows of this past season.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Season 8 Finale Special - Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 2
programmes.d: The explosive two-part reunion continues. Chelsea, Leah, Kailyn, Jenelle and Briana join Dr Drew to discuss the highs and lows of this past season.
Unseen Moments. Jenelle, Kailyn, Chelsea, Leah and Briana join Nessa to react to a collection of hilarious and intense never-before-seen clips from Teen Mom 2.
Part 2 of a look back at the biggest and most dramatic moments from past Teen Mom 2 reunions.
Reunion Part 1. Dr Drew and Nessa discuss Kailyn and Briana's fight with the cast and look back on the biggest events that happened this season.
Reunion Part 2. Dr Drew and Nessa talk to Jenelle, Chelsea, Kailyn, Leah and the rest of the cast about all the explosive moments from this season.
Unseen Moments. After the reunion fallout, Dr Drew sits down with Kailyn and Barb to check out the best unseen moments from this season.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Reunion: Behind the Screams
programmes.d: Behind The Screams. The beef between Kailyn and Briana erupts when the cast comes to New York for reunion weekend.

Kailyn comes face to face with Javi's pregnant girlfriend. Chelsea readies Aubree for her first visit with Adam at the Center. Briana tells DeVoin to move out. Jenelle and Nathan square off. (S9, ep1)
Briana invites Luis to Stella's first birthday, but he has other plans. Chelsea waits for Adam to schedule another visit with Aubree. Isaac visits Javi's house. (S9, ep2)
